scope: Independent browser-memory SAVIA POS demonstration; DOM simulation only
runner: Node test runner with an existing external jsdom installation; no install, browser, build or SQL

model_contract.declined: cart and stock unchanged; no sale created
model_contract.approved: stock decremented once; cart emptied; demo sale recorded
model_contract.cancelled_sale: stock restored once; duplicate cancellation rejected
model_contract.reset: fixtures restored; cart and sales cleared

planned_ui_cases: Initial mount, explicit demo/memory/no-real-payments notices, empty cart and disabled checkout
Search/category result changes do not mutate stock or cart
Size selection required; unavailable size cannot be added; actionable error feedback and focus
Add, change quantity and remove preserve sensible focus and product/size accessible names
Approval creates a demo receipt and stock change; repeat action cannot duplicate sale
Decline preserves cart and stock and gives clear recoverable feedback
Cancel one sale restores its stock exactly once
Reset discards local scenario and returns usable focus/initial state
Connection unavailable with explicit virtual transport; no real network request or fallback authority
publication_boundary: prepare.py reads only build-inputs/static and three src modules; Wrangler assets directory is dist; dev/savia-demo-ui requires explicit separate packaging
limits: Tests have not been run by this agent
DOM simulation does not prove pixels, responsive/touch behavior, actual screen-reader behavior or performance
API diagnostic uses separate synthetic XXX fixture; not the USD sample till
No sales/payment API, real ERP, SQL verification or remote delivery claim
